public_title: A pilot study of the pharmacokinetics, efficacy, and acceptability of a novel nicotine inhaler in smokers
scientific_title: A pilot study of the pharmacokinetics, affect on Smoking Urges, and acceptability of a novel nicotine inhaler in smokers
description: Cross over study.  Interventions: on the first day one smoked cigarette, on the second day 1 inhalation of 50 micrograms of nicotine inhaler every 30s for 5 minutes, on the third day 1 inhalation of 100 micrograms of nicotine inhaler every 30s for 5 min.  This allows for a 24-hour wash-out
secondary_outcome: Acceptability, Cigarette Evaluation Scale, Questionnaire of Smoking Urges.
exclusion_criteria: Recent use of other nicotine replacement therapy such as bupropion; cardiovascular, psychiatric history of note.
summary: A pilot study to test the hypothesis that this novel nicotine inhaler will provide a pharmacokinetic profile very similar to that produced by smoking a cigarette and thus will be effective in reducing smoking urges
